title: Crestron Multiple Products CTP Console Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of all Crestron products. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the two built-in accounts on all Crestron devices. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code under the context of Administrator.
